$comment: What the creative hotbar places (docs/ITEMS.md). Each item names the block it places (shared/blocks) and its height in ½ m cells (`rows`, up to 2). Owner, 2026-10-28: the hotbar's blocks are ½ m (the 1 m items are gone; `rows` stays for a taller piece later). `drag`: what holding Place does with it (docs/ITEMS.md §5): `modes` (the default) builds on in the build mode, for a plain block only; `vertical` a line straight up or down only, each piece where it is held (ladders on their wall); `none` one click at a time (a block with other cells or something to stand on). The order is the hotbar's. Prototype content. Run `node shared/items/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-game/src/items.gen.rs is stale.

buildModes.$comment: What holding Place does after the first block (docs/ITEMS.md §5; owner, 2026-10-28): keep building as the aim moves, in the mode chosen. `key` (KeyboardEvent.code) cycles the modes, as does the controller's buildMode button (shared/input/gamepad.json) and the touch Build button; the first is the default. Kinds (the engine's vocabulary, crates/dwell-game/src/build_drag.rs): `line` builds on in a straight line out of the face first clicked, as far as the aim reaches along it; `level` paints the cells the aim sweeps over at the first block's level (floors and ceilings). `clearance` (m): how far the player's own body must be clear of a cell before a block goes in it (above it, jumping, when towering): the server sees the body a little later, and refuses a block placed into it.
